configurations._comment: ATTACH to the server Mikael already runs on 5500 (no command = no new process). This is the default: autoPort used to hand every preview the next free port, so 5500/5501/5502 piled up and it stopped being obvious which tab was which. One fixed port, one server, always.
configurations.name: game

configurations._comment: Fallback for when nothing is listening on 5500. Pinned to 5500 so it cannot start the port pile-up autoPort used to cause.
configurations.name: game-server

configurations._comment: USE THIS WHENEVER THE SESSION'S CWD IS NOT THE MAIN CHECKOUT (a git worktree under .claude/worktrees/, or any parallel branch). launch.json is a TRACKED file, so every worktree inherits the `game` attach config above - and attaching would silently preview the MAIN checkout's files while you edit the worktree's, which looks like edits not taking effect. autoPort is correct here: a worktree genuinely needs its own server rooted in its own directory, so a second port is the point rather than the problem.
configurations.name: game-worktree
